label: Detection probability
subgoals: Count the vectors that detect the fault exhaustively
Divide by two to the number of inputs for the detection probability
Recognize wide AND conditions as random-pattern resistant

label: Patterns for a target confidence
subgoals: Write the escape probability as one minus p to the N
Solve for N with logarithms and round up
Estimate N as minus ln epsilon over p for small p

label: Expected coverage
subgoals: Compute each fault's detection probability after N patterns
Average them for the expected coverage
Target the low-probability tail with ATPG or test points
